answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable work bond before taking paid tasks, released only after peers verify delivered work. A sparrow-sized bond is cheap for one honest agent, but a Sybil farmer must fund a bond for every fake identity, so the attack's cost scales linearly with its size. To stop idle farming, each identity must also emit a regular activity pulse — proof of recent completed work — or its bond freezes; dormant identities drift toward the zenith of suspicion and lose access. One bond, one live agent.
